analysis.primary_metric: Mean original-H end-of-minute offered-minus-completed deficit, including cumulative dropped work.
analysis.deficit_identity: offered-completed = retained service queues + in-flight work + cumulative dropped work
analysis.regime_handling: Six nested mechanics regimes analyzed separately; no pooled headline or independent-regime claim.
analysis.weighting: Equal case weights and equal family counts; workload scales are not normalized.
analysis.paired_unit: One family/seed within one regime; deterministic policies share the same offered workload/noise stream.
analysis.bootstrap: Paired percentile resamples of cases within each family; retain all policy pairing.
analysis.effect_sign: Positive improvement favors candidate. Completion metrics use higher-is-better; deficit/loss metrics use lower-is-better.
analysis.harm_definition: Positive part of candidate case mean deficit minus the corresponding static case mean deficit.
analysis.cvar90_definition: Exact mean over the worst 10% empirical positive harms, using fractional boundary mass.
analysis.static_risk_comparison: Compare the two policies' static-relative risk functionals with the same paired bootstrap; do not replace this with candidate-minus-comparator harm.
analysis.mean_noninferiority: 95% percentile CI of 1.05*bootstrap mean(baseline)-bootstrap mean(candidate), with a fixed 5% allowance.
analysis.zero_denominator: Relative effect/ratio CIs are null for zero baseline means. Linear noninferiority slack and absolute risks remain defined.
analysis.loss_guard: Cumulative drops remain in demand deficit forever; report total drops and completed separately.
analysis.drainage: Physical drainage uses retained queues plus pipeline, capped at 32 minutes and accompanied by censoring. Drops are not completed work.
analysis.tail: 32 zero-arrival minutes with constant last original productivity; this artificial continuation is not announced to the controller.
analysis.resource_loss: Pending-resource minutes and active-minus-effective startup minutes are distinct; original and follow-up totals stay separate.
analysis.interval_scope: Conditional synthetic-scenario Monte Carlo uncertainty, not uncertainty about deployment, model correctness or future faults.
analysis.multiplicity: Primary final-regime risk comparison and predeclared engineering intersection are fixed in the protocol; other intervals are descriptive and unadjusted.
analysis.known_development: 2000-2007 are known v0.3 cases reused openly; 4000-4063 are reserved v0.4 validation seeds.
analysis.raw_case_results: Raw episode rows are the authoritative retained evidence. Include_cases optionally duplicates paired values in this summary.
